pr_title: drivers: dai: sai: don't crash on underrun/overrun
pr_body:
TX/RX FIFO underrun shouldn't crash the RTOS when it occurs. Also, since this can also happen under "normal" conditions (i.e: DMA doesn't copy data fast enough from/to SAI's FIFOs) the software should be able to recover from it.

As such:
	1) Remove `z_irq_spurious()` call.
	2) Clear error flag
	3) De-escalate error message to warning message

Fixes #77633

RTOS will crash if there's a FIFO underrun/overrun because of a `z_irq_spurious()` call in the error ISR. Issue was observed while adding support for a new platform in SOF.

**Expected behavior**
<!--
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->

RTOS shouldn't crash. Instead, the error flag should be cleared and the transmit/receive operations should continue.


Fixed by: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/77236
